title: Dithionite and sulfinate complexes from the reaction of SO2 with decamethylsamarocene

material_class.structural_family: dimeric samarocene sulfinate with an eight-membered Sm2(O-S-O)2 ring

synthesis.procedure: Under rigorous exclusion of oxygen and moisture (Schlenk line or argon glovebox), SO2 (0.3 mmol) was condensed onto a stirred THF solution (20 mL) of [(η5-C5Me5)2Sm(THF)2] (170 mg, 0.3 mmol) at −50 °C. The mixture turned yellow immediately, was stirred for 1 h at −50 °C, and stored overnight without stirring. Orange crystals of 1 formed and were collected by filtration (46 mg, 25%).
synthesis.time: stirred 1 h at −50 °C, then stored overnight without stirring
synthesis.vessel_or_method: flame-dried Schlenk glassware / argon-filled glovebox; SO2 condensed onto the solution
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: orange crystals of 1 suitable for X-ray diffraction formed from the reaction mixture and were collected by filtration

properties.summary: NIR absorption of 1 shows a characteristic Sm(III) ligand-field pattern. Magnetic (SQUID) data for 1 are referred to the ESI and were not numerically reported in the main text.

measurements.name: NIR absorption bands (ATR)
measurements.conditions: solid ATR; assigned to Sm(III) 6H5/2 → 6F9/2, 6F7/2, 6F5/2, 6H15/2 and 6F3/2 transitions

measurements.name: SQUID magnetization/susceptibility
measurements.conditions: microcrystalline/powder samples; 1 T; 2–300 K; main-text numerical data not given (ESI)

source_locations.location: Experimental, crystal data and elemental analysis for 1
Results (NIR of 1); Experimental SQUID methods; magnetic data of 1 directed to ESI

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear mixed dithionite–sulfinate cluster of metallocene and half-sandwich Sm units

synthesis.procedure: After isolation of 1 from the SO2 / [(η5-C5Me5)2Sm(THF)2] reaction in THF at −50 °C, THF was removed from the filtrate in vacuo. The residue was washed with 15 mL of n-pentane. The pentane-insoluble residue was recrystallized from toluene (10 mL) to give yellow crystals of 2·2(C6H5CH3) (15 mg, 9%). Additional crystals of 2 were obtained from the n-pentane solution after 1 week.
synthesis.temperature: reaction at −50 °C; recrystallization from toluene (temperature not specified)
synthesis.time: reaction stirred 1 h then stored overnight; n-pentane crop stored 1 week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk / argon glovebox; filtrate workup after isolation of 1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: THF evaporated from the filtrate; residue washed with n-pentane; insoluble residue recrystallized from toluene (10 mL) to give yellow crystals of 2·2(toluene)

properties.summary: NIR absorption of 2 exhibits a Sm(III) pattern comparable to known Sm3+ spectra; no numerical magnetic data for 2 are given in the main text.

measurements.name: NIR absorption bands (ATR)
measurements.conditions: solid ATR; assigned to transitions from 6H5/2 to 6F9/2, 6F7/2, 6H15/2 and 6F3/2

source_locations.location: Results, NIR spectroscopy of 2; Fig. S1/S2 referenced in ESI

synthesis.procedure: From the same SO2 / [(η5-C5Me5)2Sm(THF)2] reaction used for 1 and 2, storage of the yellow n-pentane washings for 1 week gave a mixture of crystals including yellow crystals of minor product 3, which were separated by hand. Bulk 3 could not be separated from mixtures with 2.
synthesis.temperature: reaction at −50 °C; crystallization from n-pentane (temperature not specified)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk / argon glovebox; hand separation of mixed crystals
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: n-pentane solution stored 1 week; yellow crystals of 3 obtained as a minor product mixed with 2 and 4 and separated by hand
synthesis.yield: minor product; bulk yield not reported

source_locations.location: Results and Experimental crystal data for 3 (asymmetric unit C20H30O2SSm)

synthesis.procedure: From the same SO2 / [(η5-C5Me5)2Sm(THF)2] reaction, storage of the n-pentane solution for 1 week gave a mixture of crystals including yellow crystals of minor product 4, separated by hand. Bulk 4 could not be isolated free of 2.
synthesis.temperature: reaction at −50 °C; crystallization from n-pentane (temperature not specified)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk / argon glovebox; hand separation of mixed crystals
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: n-pentane solution stored 1 week; yellow crystals of 4 obtained as a minor product mixed with 2 and 3 and separated by hand
synthesis.yield: minor product; bulk yield not reported
